race.comment: FIFTH FORCE (6) was a big improver third-up when rising to the mile third-up, where he only saw clear air halfway down the straight and knuckled down strongly to grab third. He's drawn to get back but from the draw, but keeps the 3kg claim and if the tempo is genuine, he can round them up late. CARNEGIE HILL (2) is the main danger if his latest wide run at Gold Coast is forgiven, with his previous efforts read strongly and his record around this trip a clear plus. GLOUNTHAUNE (7) hasn't won for a long time but had excuses last time when blundering and being held up. Still unsure what his best trip is but there's peaks there that would prove very effective if he can produce. SNUGG (10) comes through a metro company at Doomben where she was slow away and made late ground. Yet to tackle the mile but her splits suggest she will relish it. THE TORQUE FACTOR (5) dominated them last time here, so has to be taken seriously.
